g.text: The manager container is rebuilt and recreated: its web UI is unavailable for a short time and terminals or captures open in it end. Lab
containers keep running. A first setup asks you to create the clab-discovery password in the terminal.
Manager data, saved passwords, the clab-backup-ui/.env settings (or the defaults: all VM interfaces, port 8081) and every lab container.
Install missing prerequisites: Git, SSH, Docker/Compose and containerlab.
Check UTC/NTP before APT; wait briefly for active time sync without changing time settings.
Retain compatible installed tools; start Docker and SSH services.
Prepare persistent storage and restricted clab-discovery password/helpers.
Existing password/data retained; first setup asks you to create the password.
Rebuild/recreate only the manager; existing lab containers remain in place.
Lab operations: enabled with default trusted roots
Browser Wireshark: pull the pinned Wireshark image, build the session service, start Edgeshark (localhost 5001/5801).
Engineer access: set up for student (VS Code, Containerlab extension)
Settings: retain current .env or use defaults
Installation-media APT repair: enabled with backup
lazydocker: install or update for student (never fails the installation).
Check running version/HTTP, then set up Git under student.
may ask for your sudo password
uses the terminal, after the manager
Start runs these phases. Cancel returns to the dashboard without changing anything.
